question: Name the Government scheme aimed to benefit women entrepreneurs from backward backgrounds or poor backgrounds.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahila Samriddhi Yojana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Mahila Samriddhi Yojana** was launched by the **Ministry of Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises**, Government of India.
 
• It focuses on providing support to women entrepreneurs, especially those from backward and poor backgrounds.
 
• The primary aim of this initiative is to foster women's entrepreneurship by providing them with training, financial aid, and market linkages to promote their business ventures.
 
• The government also offers special incentives and concessions to women entrepreneurs under this scheme to help them establish themselves in the competitive marketplace.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ujjawala**

 
 
• Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana is a scheme of the Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas for providing LPG connections to women from Below Poverty Line (BPL) households. The scheme was launched on 1st May 2016 in Ballia, Uttar Pradesh.
 
 
 
• **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao**
 
 
• This is a flagship program launched by the Government of India aiming to address the declining Child Sex Ratio (CSR) and other related issues of women's empowerment.
 
• The goal of the scheme includes preventing gender-biased sex selective elimination, ensuring the survival and protection of the girl child, and ensuring education and participation of the girl child.
 
• It is not specifically targeted towards supporting women entrepreneurs.
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana**
 
 
• The Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana is a maternity benefit program run by the government of India.
 
• It aims to provide partial wage compensation to women for wage loss during childbirth and childcare.
 
• This gives them the time they require to recover before they start working again. This is a type of maternal benefit rather than a scheme supporting entrepreneurship.
